title: Tenant settings
description: The settings of one tenant of one application (master plan 14.2): defaults and policy for every user of the tenant. Policy only narrows what the deployment level allows: voice, attachments and history export are off until the deployment level allows them, retention and attachment size are ceilings, a capability any level switches off is off, and extra confirmation takes the lowest threshold. Every member is optional (absent means inherit) and the document is closed: a member that is not listed does not exist. There is no member that enables a tool, names a scope or role, lowers or skips a confirmation, reaches LocalAI or any runtime, selects an external or hybrid mode, changes data egress, holds a credential or raises a budget; a document that names one is refused whole and nothing is stored. The key (application, tenant) comes from the verified token, never from the body.

default_language.description: The language used when a user states none. Must be one the application's active package supports.

default_model_profile.description: The approved model and resource profile used when a user states none. Refused unless the operator approved it.

capabilities.description: Capabilities switched off for every user of the tenant. Narrowing only.

confirmation.description: Confirmation asked for every user of the tenant in addition to the platform's. Raising only.
